headline: Taco Bell Awards $13M in Scholarships With No GPA Required
meta_description: Taco Bell is distributing $13 million in scholarships to students regardless of academic performance, removing a traditional barrier to educational funding.
summary_short: Taco Bell is giving away $13 million in scholarships—and grade point average won't disqualify you from applying.
body:
Taco Bell is distributing $13 million in scholarships to students, with one major difference from traditional education funding: applicants don't need to meet a minimum GPA requirement.

The initiative removes a common barrier that has historically excluded capable students from accessing scholarship money. By eliminating the grade-point average threshold, Taco Bell is broadening opportunity beyond academic metrics alone, recognizing that financial need and potential extend across the full spectrum of student backgrounds.

This approach acknowledges that scholarships can play a life-changing role for students facing economic hardship, regardless of how their transcript looks. The $13 million commitment represents a significant investment in removing obstacles to higher education access.
quick_facts: $13 million in total scholarship funding available
No minimum GPA requirement to apply
Removes traditional academic barriers to funding
